layout.point1: Transcribes your Plaud recordings on infrastructure you control.
layout.point2: Long recordings are split at natural pauses and resume after an interruption.
layout.point3: Open source under AGPL-3.0. Read the code or contribute on GitHub.

reconnect.title: Reconnecting…
reconnect.working: Signing in to your local account.
reconnect.failed: OpenAudioHub could not sign this window in. Quit and reopen the app.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to your OpenAudioHub instance.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Create the account you will use to sign in to this instance.
register.name: Name
register.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
register.disabled: Registration is disabled on this instance

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.checkSubtitle: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.
forgot.unavailableSubtitle: We could not check whether password reset is available.
forgot.noAnswer: The server did not answer. Try again in a moment.
forgot.smtpTitle: Reset emails are turned off on this server.
forgot.smtpBody: The administrator hasn't configured SMTP, so reset emails can't be delivered. Set SMTP_HOST, SMTP_USER, and SMTP_PASSWORD in the server environment to enable it. Until then, an administrator can reset it for you directly in the database.
forgot.smtpSubtitle: Password reset needs a mail server to be set up.
forgot.failed: Could not send the reset email. Try again.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Pick a password that's unique to this account.
reset.success: Password reset. You can sign in now.
reset.failed: Could not reset password. The link may have expired.
reset.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
reset.invalidSubtitle: This link is missing or has expired.
reset.expired: This reset link has expired or was used already. Request a new link to continue.
reset.missing: Use the link in your latest reset email, or ask for a fresh one.

suspended.title: Your account is suspended
suspended.line1: While we review your account, recordings, sync, and transcription are on hold.
suspended.line2: Contact the administrator of this instance if you think this is a mistake.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may be out of date, or the page may have moved.
